notes: Official Samsung datasheet "Digital Signage QBB/QMB/QHB 4K UHD Display Series" (DIGSIG-QBBQMBQHB-DSHT-JUL22T), cross-checked against Samsung's Latin America QB65B product page (samsung.com/latin_en/business/.../lh65qbbebgcxgo/). Full model/SKU: LH65QBBEBGCXGO (LATAM); US SKU is the equivalent LH65QBB-series unit (Samsung's US support page for "QBB Series Digital Signage QB65B" confirms LH65QBBEBGCXGO as the referenced model but does not surface a specs table directly). Not rack-mountable — 65" wall/stand-mount commercial display, VESA 400x400. No DisplayPort input (DP is exclusive to the QM65B/QH65B tiers of this same series — QB65B is HDMI-only for video input). Built-in 10W x2ch speakers. Power connector style (IEC vs captive cord) and RJ45 link speed were not explicitly stated in the source and are flagged inline on the relevant ports; everything else (HDMI 2.0 x3 w/ARC, USB 2.0 x2, RS232C in/out, RJ45, IR, stereo mini-jack audio out, AC 100-240V power) is taken directly from Samsung's official spec table and connectivity diagram.

ports.name: HDMI 3
ports.note: Datasheet lists 3x HDMI 2.0 total (1 ARC-capable); individual numbering beyond the ARC port is not itemized in the source, so ports 2/3 are inferred from the '(3)' port count.

ports.name: RJ45
ports.note: Ethernet speed (10/100 vs Gigabit) not stated in source datasheet; grade omitted

ports.name: RS232C In
ports.note: Spec table lists 'RS232C (in/out)'; two identical RS232C ports shown in connectivity diagram (items 8 & 9). Included accessory is an 'RS232C (IN) Gender' adapter, consistent with an In/Out daisy-chain pair typical of Samsung signage.

ports.name: IR
ports.note: IR sensor/extender input, item 10 in Samsung's connectivity diagram

ports.name: Speaker Jack
ports.note: Labeled 'Speaker Jack' on rear panel diagram; spec table lists this as 'Output Audio: Stereo Mini Jack'. Display also has a built-in 10W x2ch amplifier (not a separate physical port).

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Power Supply spec: AC 100-240V 50/60Hz. Exact inlet style (IEC C13/C14) not explicitly labeled in the datasheet; inferred from the included detachable 'Power Cord' accessory and standard practice for this display class/size — verify before relying on it for cable matching.
